newsitem.title: NORWAY: Braathens SAFE says to expand incentive programme.
newsitem.headline: Braathens SAFE says to expand incentive programme.

text.p: Norwegian airline Braathens SAFE said on Friday it would extend its frequent flyer programme, which is linked to British Airways' programme, to domestic Swedish airline Transwede Airways AS.

Braathens SAFE managing director Erik Braathen told Reuters in an interview that its incentive programme, called the BRACard, would be expanded to include flights on Transwede, of which it owns 50 percent.
Initially, Braathens SAFE's plans for Transwede were to lay down a sound financial structure and then to hit the Swedish market.
"First of all our intention is to get firm ground under our feet -- to make sure that we negotiate the various agreements so we get a good footing in terms of the cost structure.
